types.title: Record types
types.subtitle: Your own things, set up without code: fields, numbers, statuses, who may do what
types.intro: A record type is anything your company keeps a register of — a site visit, a prescription, a trip, a project. Give it fields, a number series and statuses, and it gets its own list in the menu.
types.noneBody: Make the first one: name it, add its fields, and it is ready to use.
types.menuHidden: Not shown in the left menu
types.archive: Archive (keeps its records, stops new ones)
types.deleteBody: It has no records, so nothing is lost. Its name and number prefix become free again.

ed.readyBody: Everything is in place. Save it and people can start adding records.
ed.readyWith_one: In use: {{count}} record so far. Fields and statuses that records hold can't be removed.
ed.readyWith_other: In use: {{count}} records so far. Fields and statuses that records hold can't be removed.
ed.pName: Give the record type a name (2 letters or more)
ed.pPlural: Say what many of them are called (the name of the list)
ed.pPrefix: Choose a number prefix: 1 to 8 capital letters or digits, starting with a letter (SV, RX, TRIP)
ed.pSection: Type a name for the new menu section, or choose another place
ed.name: Name (one of them)
ed.plural: Name of the list (many of them)
ed.pluralHint: Shown in the menu and on top of the list
ed.prefixHint: Records are numbered {{example}}, starting again every financial year
ed.titleFieldHint: The field people read first in lists and links
ed.menuPlaceHint: People see it only if they may view these records
ed.menuHidden: Do not show in the menu
ed.fieldsHint: The fields of one record. Every field type of a process form works here: lists, links, formulas, photos.
ed.linesHint: A table inside the record: items, visits, instalments. Every line has the same columns.
ed.statusesHint: Where a record can stand. The colour is one of the fixed status colours and always comes with an icon.
ed.movesHint: The buttons that take a record from one status to another, and who may press each one.

who.edit: Anyone who may change these records
who.creator: The person who made the record

perm.hint: Tick what everyone may do, or what each role may do. The server checks this on every screen, list, export and file.
perm.adminNote: The owner and admins can always do everything. Approvers are the people the “Approvers” moves are for.

list.search: Search number, title or any value
list.columnsHint: Tick the columns to show (up to {{max}}) and put them in order.
list.emptyBody: Add the first one, or import a list from Excel.
list.noMatchBody: Change the search or remove a filter.
list.noAccess: Ask an admin if you should see these records.
list.archived: This record type is archived: its records stay, new ones can't be added.

views.title: Views
views.saveHint: Keeps the search, filters, sort and columns you see now.
views.name: Name of the view
views.share: Share with everyone who can see these records

import.title: Import {{name}}
import.hint: The first row names the fields: {{fields}}. Dates as DD/MM/YYYY. Nothing is saved unless every line is right.
import.file: Open an Excel or CSV file

drawer.noNotes: No notes yet. Anything written here stays with the record.
drawer.deleteBody: It leaves every list but stays in the history. Its number is not used again.
